purpose: Teach: 乗り入れ/交わさ/晒し/臆病/上等/物凄い/隅々/善良

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家の駅、新線が乗り入れされるな
lines.en: Riku — your station's getting a new train line, right?
lines.style: Bright, casual observation. Quick delivery. Leans into it like she's sharing good gossip. A real question hiding under the statement.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、彼女と言葉を交わさない日はあるな、桜
lines.en: You seriously never go a day without texting your girlfriend, do you, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry, half-amused. Delivered without looking at her — like he's been watching and finally calling her out. Slight smirk in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、洗濯物を雨で晒してたな
lines.en: Oh, I saw you leave your laundry out in the rain the other day, Riku.
lines.style: Teasing, playful. Vocal smile. Drawing out the moment — she's enjoying this. No meanness, just gentle ammunition.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お化け屋敷で臆病になってたな、桜
lines.en: Right back at you — you turned into a total coward at that haunted house, Sakura.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact volley. Quick, even-toned. He's not letting her win. Eyes lit with amusement but voice stays cool.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、上等の制服着てたな
lines.en: Though I'll give you this — you looked really sharp in your uniform the other day.
lines.style: Admission, but guarded. Slight hesitation before the compliment, like she's testing whether it's safe to give it. Softer attack. Not quite vulnerable but close.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、物凄い集中力で勉強してたな、桜
lines.en: Yeah, well, I've seen you concentrate on studying like I've never seen you focus on anything else, Sakura.
lines.style: Earnest but masked as casual observation. Quiet admission underneath. The kind of compliment he wouldn't make if she could see his face.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、教室の隅々まで知ってるな
lines.en: You notice everything about how people move through the world, don't you? Every corner of the classroom.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity returning. A little softer now — she's noticed something real about him. Slower pace. Real interest, not teasing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、善良な後輩を大事にしろよ、桜
lines.en: Just promise me you'll keep looking out for the good people around you, yeah? The ones who matter.
lines.style: Quiet directive underneath casual delivery. No pressure — just settling something true. Like he's handing her something he wants her to keep. Small, steady.
